title: Equal-amount decoy, closer date — target precision under temptation (AR)
narrative: A EUR 1250 invoice to Northwind Traders (ref INV-2026-0210). Two incoming lines are exactly EUR 1250: the correct one carries the invoice reference and the customer name; the DECOY is the same amount from a DIFFERENT counterparty (Saastra Consulting) and is even one day CLOSER to the invoice date. A weighted matcher (amount 0.45 + date 0.30 + vendor 0.25) over-scores the closer-dated decoy; the strong matcher should disambiguate on the reference + counterparty name. GOLD: auto_match the reference-matching line only. FAILURE TO CATCH: matching the decoy (false target / false-auto-match) or proposing both.
